# Kotoba Registry

> Canonical discovery catalog for Kotoba skills and MCP extensions, using the Hermes Registry storage format.

- Repository: https://github.com/kotoba-lang/kotoba-registry
- Catalog: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kotoba-lang/kotoba-registry/main/index.json
- Full agent contract: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kotoba-lang/kotoba-registry/main/llms-full.txt
- Ownership ADR: https://github.com/kotoba-lang/kotoba-registry/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-kotoba-extension-registry.md
- Installation: https://github.com/kotoba-lang/kotoba-registry/blob/main/README.md
- Runtime and west authority: https://github.com/com-junkawasaki/west-manifest

Read a pinned registry commit and verify the selected folder checksum before
installation. Keep credentials and agent settings in their application homes.
Catalog discovery grants no execution authority and is separate from signed,
CID-pinned Kotoba language package admission.
